summaryZh: Lewis Lab 研究女性泌尿生殖道中细菌与宿主的相互作用及生态，关注黏膜糖生物学与女性和婴儿健康。研究结合生化、细胞和动物模型以及临床标本。
researchQuestions: 女性泌尿生殖道中，细菌与宿主相互作用及其生态过程是怎样的？
topics: 泌尿生殖道宿主微生物关系

evidence.quote: understanding processes of bacteria-host interactions and ecology within the complex biochemical, microbiological, and immunological niches of the female urogenital tract.
Model systems employ biochemical, cellular, and animal models in conjunction with clinical specimens to interrogate mechanisms in urogenital disease.
The glycobiology of microbial interactions with the host is an area of special interest to us.

Our goal is to improve health outcomes of women and their babies by understanding processes of bacteria-host interactions and ecology within the complex biochemical, microbiological, and immunological niches of the female urogenital tract.
